CustomField.description: Written by: call 1, on fact families only. Read by: partial-evidence accrual. Full when the words carry every element, Partial when they carry some. Partial is the instructed default under doubt, because a partial accrues safely and places nobody. BLANK ON SENTIMENT BY DESIGN: a sentiment read is whole and accumulation is the counter's job, per P8.4, so there is no partial to record.
